name: 1Password Developer Environments
description: Manage 1Password Developer Environments and secret-backed local mounts without returning secret values

contributions.name: 1Password Developer Environments
contributions.description: Manage Environment metadata and local mounts through the desktop-app MCP server without returning secrets
contributions.instructions: Use 1Password for agent and factory credentials without returning secret values to the model. Authenticate and list Environment names, variable names, and local mounts before changing anything. Reuse the requested Environment and mount when available. Environment changes and mount creation require Allow write tools and tool approval under the current permission rules. Keep 1Password desktop authorization in place. Use an approved local mount only with the intended process. Never read, print, copy, or commit mounted secret values. Never request secret values in chat or put them in tool arguments. Use append_variables only for non-secret values supplied for this task; enter secret values through 1Password itself. Do not change agent permissions or expand credential scope to bypass approval. Unattended factories need a separately provisioned, least-privilege credential path; desktop authorization does not guarantee unattended access.
